topics.title: Cool Tech For UpKeep
topics.summary: Smart glasses, nameplate scans, leak shutoffs and more.
topics.detail: 13 tools with current prices: Meta glasses for hands-free visit clips (LED shows when recording; Michigan lets participants record their own conversations, but get the member's OK in their home), nameplate OCR into the home record, QR tags, thermal camera, moisture meter, borescope, smart leak shutoffs as an add-on, thermostat alerts, drone roof checks (Part 107), 3D scans, AI defect spotting and AR overlays.

topics.title: Condensed Investor Pitch Deck
topics.summary: 10 slides, a 3-slide teaser and a one-page memo.
topics.detail: Investors spend about 3 minutes on a deck, most of it on the business model, product and traction. A 10-slide order, teaser and memo formats, Airbnb and Uber lessons, common mistakes, and drafts for UpKeep and the construction home record.

topics.title: UpKeep Tech Training Week
topics.summary: Five days in a conference room, then ride-alongs.
topics.detail: Teach the house as six systems with animated explainers, a house-in-a-box demo board and photo defect drills, then simulated visits from photo sets and a Friday checkout test. Roofs, live gas and real customers wait for week 2 ride-alongs.

topics.title: Coder's Dictionary
topics.summary: 60 AI coding words with prompts to copy.
topics.detail: 60 words developers and vibe-coders use with AI coding tools, in 6 categories (Visual Polish, Fixing, Building, Quality, Shipping, Prompting the AI). Each has a plain meaning, when to say it, and a prompt line to copy.

topics.title: UpKeep Pricing Forecast
topics.summary: Plus is the likely pick; about $228/mo average.
topics.detail: Base case: 30% Essentials, 55% Plus, 15% Complete, about $167/mo on tiers plus $61 in add-ons, so about $228/mo per customer (range $189 to $278). Top add-on is lawn mowing, then snow, pest, leaf cleanup, windows and pressure washing.

topics.title: Founder And App Security
topics.detail: Start with a password manager and passkeys on email, GitHub, Stripe and the domain registrar, then offline recovery codes, scoped expiring tokens for agents, and approval before agents publish or send.

topics.title: Agent Dashboard Product
topics.summary: Plan to sell the dashboard setup.
topics.detail: Package this agent dashboard setup for contractors and small teams: what is included, pricing, a pilot offer and next steps. Lemon Squeezy versus Gumroad is still open.

topics.title: Smart Upkeep Deep Dive
topics.detail: Ideas like a named tech every visit, a partner vetting checklist before any sub works, and the Michigan 3-day cancel notice for in-home sign-ups.

topics.title: Smart Upkeep Membership Add-Ons
topics.detail: Lawn, snow, pest, leaf cleanup, windows and pressure washing. Base case attach rates add about $61 per member per month on top of tiers.

topics.title: Home Guide QR Stickers
topics.summary: Stickers that open the right page.
topics.detail: Stickers on the furnace, water heater and panel that open that unit's Home Guide page (model, manual, service history). Needs per-section links first.

topics.title: Daily Ideas App
topics.summary: A daily feed of sourced ideas.
topics.detail: A daily feed of sourced app and service ideas to swipe through and vote on.

topics.title: Checkout And Selling
topics.summary: How to take payment and sell.
topics.detail: Ways to take payment and sell online, starting with Lemon Squeezy versus Gumroad for the dashboard setup.

topics.title: Offline Shutoffs And Emergency Info
topics.summary: Pages that work with no internet.
topics.detail: Home Guide shutoff and emergency pages cached so they still open when power or internet is out.
